scope: Eighty source delegations restored to the existing native shared APIs, plus one missing native state-based removal path. Native call identities are checked directly rather than inferred from expanded decompiler output. No new handler/body count or full post-edit similarity score is claimed.

compiled_verification.scope: Actual shared callee edges in fresh current public/checked compiler-worker bounds, six unchanged shared helper definitions, thirty-two source-file projections, and conditional API/early-return paths for native/rebuilt Takklemaggot. Static call occurrence counts are not runtime execution counts. No post-edit full similarity or gameplay-equivalence claim.

current_source_check.scope: Current configuration inputs only. Historical source-edit replay, archived builds, supporting proof inputs and native semantic audits are not rerun. Historical replay availability is recorded in docs/recovery-evidence/historical-artifact-retirement.json.

outlined_damage_false_positive.name: new_damage_all
outlined_damage_false_positive.resolution: The apparent missing damage action is in a checked private compiler worker reached directly from the public entry. No source edit is needed; direct entry-only call inventories must follow verified workers before absence claims.

review: Previous goal turn reconstructed five native buffer initializers and verified their complete buffer bytes and alignment paths; that was progress. This batch restores native source-level API sharing in eighty card functions and corrects one omitted native control-flow path.

The call-count screen has only two candidates with a completely absent mutating public callee: Takklemaggot kill_card and new_damage_all damage_creature. The latter public entry is 55 bytes and directly jumps to a 557-byte same-source .part.0 worker whose fresh DWARF range contains damage_creature. No damage implementation edit is needed.

The native Takklemaggot code checks is_this_dying first, then check_for_death_trigger_removal. A true removal check branches to kill_card(player,card,17) and returns zero; a false check reaches create_legacy_effect. The old source reversed the two checks and omitted the state-based kill/early-return path.

Other apparent missing callees are often expanded shared implementations in the decompiled source. Native instructions and exact COFF identities establish the original shared APIs before editing; six reused helper definitions remain unchanged and had exact full-function C626 scores.

Fifty-five card owners use basic_spell instead of its eight-argument generic_spell forwarding expression, preserving both event and EVENT_CAN_CAST operands. Seventeen use global_enchantment instead of its common castability and AI-score branch. Four token owners use generic_token, and two creatures use flash.

Aesi uses the existing card_exploration helper for land-play checks and common enchantment events. Deepwood Legate uses card_nantuko_shade instead of its expanded fixed black-mana +1/+1 activation expressions on both existing returns. The compiler merges those two source paths to one actual native-style call.

The eighty delegation restorations reuse existing APIs; they are not eighty newly recovered handlers or eighty independent gameplay bug fixes. No compatibility aliases, duplicated helpers or code-generation attributes are introduced.

One combined build passes. Fresh DWARF bounds and actual callee targets verify all 81 handlers; conditional next-call traces verify native/rebuilt Takklemaggot dying/removal/legacy choices and the kill-mode/zero return. All thirty-two complete source files reproduce from their pre-batch versions using only the recorded fragments.

Current source/name pins, six unchanged helper definitions and existing staging pass. The historical full comparison remains a discovery snapshot; no post-batch whole-function score or transitive gameplay-equivalence claim is made.
